name: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited
summary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited develops and operates theme-based entertainment destinations in India. It operates through Parks and Hotel Divisions. The company operates theme, water, and snow parks under the Imagicaa brand; and operates a hotel under the Novotel Imagicaa Khopoli brand. It also provides food and beverage, merchandise, and other services; parking, lockers, sponsorships, revenue sharing agreements, lease rentals, etc.; hotel accommodation; and operates devotional park, and park and hotel restaurants.
